messages:
anya (design): dropping a small UI idea: a 'role pill' next to the Add button that preselects Viewer/Editor/Admin and opens the invite drawer with that role prefilled. lightweight, discoverable. mock in figma link.
matt (pm): nice. keeps single-person adds quick. we still preserve full matrix for bulk edits, right?
anya (design): yes, pill is a shortcut only. full roles matrix available via 'Advanced' in the drawer.
raj (frontend): implementation plan: pill sets /invite?role=editor and focuses email input on open. will ensure Enter/Space activate.
zoe (a11y): accessibility notes: pill must use button with aria-pressed and a visible focus ring. announce prefilled role to screen readers when drawer opens using aria-live polite.
matt (pm): SSO nuance: for orgs with enforced SSO, surface an inline banner in the drawer "SSO required for sign-in" with a link to docs. non-blocking but clear.
raj (frontend): agree. banner will be role="status" on open. server will soft-validate external emails and show a warning.
zoe (a11y): if the SSO state appears after open, use role="alert" so assistive tech notices. ensure link text is descriptive: "How SSO affects invites".
anya (design): audit shortcut idea: small "Recent role changes" link in the roles header that opens audit pre-filtered to role_change and shows a 3-item micro-preview on hover. anonymize by default.
matt (pm): permission guard: non-admins get a CTA to request audit access instead of a dead 403 page.
raj (frontend): will gate client-side and rely on server masking. micro-preview will be aria-hidden until focus/hover and keyboard reveal will move focus inside. no focus trap.
ci-bot: preview deployed at https://staging.redwood.tools/role-pill/2365 build#5271 (keyboard + aria props included)
zoe (a11y): i'll run a quick NVDA pass when preview is up. priorities: pill focus, drawer aria-live announcements, banner contrast, and preview keyboard flow.
matt (pm): timeline: aiming for QAable branch by Friday. post checks and any regressions here. :thumbsup:
